theorems.name: Submission.deformation_ipl_mwc_coeff_minor_continuity
theorems.statement: ∀ (k Q : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (ψ : Eucl k → ℝ) (g : Eucl Q → ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0) (u : ℕ → Eucl k → Eucl Q) (u₀ : Eucl k → Eucl Q) (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → Fin Q) (b : Fin r → Fin k), IsOpen Ω → IntegrableOn ψ Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ j, LipschitzOnWith C (u j) Ω) → LipschitzOnWith C u₀ Ω → TendstoUniformlyOn u u₀ atTop Ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ w in Ω, ψ w * g (u j w) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ (u j) w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, ψ w * g (u₀ w) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ u₀ w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))))
